fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: A diving strike that deals 12 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Talon Take
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a strike from range that deals 20 damage. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cast Off
fusions.desc: Casts off a hawk for 12 seconds that strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, each strike with a 35% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Riding the Thermal
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina runs out, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 20 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
